result.topic_en: The page completes a determinant and degree argument showing that the coefficients a_0,…,a_n can be taken as polynomials. It derives corollaries that a system of functions of a class satisfies an n-th order linear ODE with polynomial coefficients, and that every system of the class is expressible linearly through y and its derivatives. It then begins seeking all systems with the same substitutions and exponents.

Satz die beiden Corollare:
